title: Brigitte Bardot's funeral takes place as Saint-Tropez bids adieu to cinema icon
summary: Brigitte Bardot's funeral was held on January 7 with a private service and a public homage in Saint-Tropez, the French Riviera resort where she lived for more than half a century after retiring from movie stardom at the height of her fame.
